title: SSP-7.3 — Successful Publish Reconciliation Evidence
summary: prove that successful scope Publish sets or clears only the exact current editorial public URL in the small private lineage row list
content_html:
SSP-7.3 — Successful Publish Reconciliation Evidence

Outcome

SSP-7.3 is complete. The existing scope-wide Publish apply remains the only public mutation. After its ordinary public docs, sub-scope, search, and document-location writes succeed, it checks exact configured editorial lineage rows against their actual public by-ID files and atomically updates the small private row list.

Contract Proved

  • An exact public editorial B writes publication: {public_url} using the configured public route and exact report-host doc plus B subdoc identity.
  • An absent public B writes publication: null. This covers removal after the ordinary Publish projection excludes or no longer contains B.
  • Republish after an editorial change keeps the same current URL; a retained unchanged B does not rewrite the table; rows owned by another editorial collection remain unchanged.
  • publishable remains the next-Publish inclusion gate. Replace changes neither publication evidence nor public files, and Publish rewrites neither working A nor editorial B.
  • The table stores no publication timestamp, generation hash, public bytes, history, or stage field. Publish status/confirm receives no lineage fields, apply returns no lineage-specific state, and public products contain no private source identity or table data.

Verification

  • Focused lineage and Publish reconciliation matrix: 11 passed. It covers first publication, republish after editorial change, retained B, removal, exact URL construction, exact collection ownership, and unrelated-row isolation.
  • Complete Docs Viewer Python suite: 939 passed with the configured readable/writable DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR.
  • Full Docs Viewer Python and JavaScript lint and git diff --check pass. Studio Docs and search projections are rebuilt and checked separately at this gate.

Independent Boundary Review

The diff adds one post-success call to the existing scope-wide Publish apply and one small row-list reconciliation function. It adds no Publish action, selection flow, receipt field, timestamp, digest, comparison, rollback, retry, partial-commit protocol, public runtime data, Project State change, or report presentation.

SSP-7 remains parked here. Stop before SSP-7.4 report presentation.
